calls.function: blueBundlesV1Supply((address loanToken, address collateralToken, address oracle, address irm, uint256 lltv) marketParams, uint256 assets, (uint8 kind, bytes data) loanTokenPermit, uint256 referralFeePct, address referralFeeRecipient, uint256 deadline)

free.unread: TokenLib.pullOrWrapNative reads the permit data only for kind 1 (ERC-2612) or 2 (Permit2); kind is bound to 0, which pulls the amount with transferFrom

deadline.free: a time after which the call reverts; it limits when the supply can run, not what it does

trailer.why: the Morpho app appends a 4-byte timestamp and one or two 4-byte origin tags (morpho-org/sdks, addTransactionMetadata); blueBundlesV1Supply reads only its arguments

views.function: position(bytes32 id, address user) returns (uint256 supplyShares, uint128 borrowShares, uint128 collateral)
